title: Realization of represented open ind-extension
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠D.p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and finite-type k₀-schemes X₀,Y₀. Let j₀:X₀→Y₀ be a quasi-compact open immersion and let j be its geometric base change [def-zl-weil-geometric-fiber-properties]. Let S be any normalized compact-support coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] for the compactification (j,id). For constructible Weil sheaves F on X₀ and G on Y₀ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and any representation e:y_Y(G)≅j_!(y_X(F)) in the specified equivariant ind-category [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], there is an isomorphism G.carrier≅S(F.carrier) in the existing common-stage constructible category. There is no proper image, cohomology degree or composite compactification in this statement. No absolute separatedness is assumed.

source.document: SGA 4, XVII, §5.1; Bhatt–Scholze, Definition 6.7.6 and Lemma 6.7.7
source.place: Exact extension by zero, the open adjunction, and normalized completed coefficient realization.

proof.text: For the identity-proper compactification, the projection-normalized completed realization identifies the integral operation with exact extension by zero. At each positive quotient it is precisely the ordinary open extension. Its open unit and counit commute with coefficient extension, so raw rationalization and common-stage descent give the same adjunction and preserve the standard heart. No absolute separatedness enters this local open construction.

Transport the heart adjunction through AsSmall and extend by filtered colimits. The Yoneda Kan unit identifies the extension on represented objects. The fixed-pair adjunction uses the left mate of the prescribed Frobenius pullback square, hence uniqueness of left adjoints identifies it with the specified ind open extension. Full faithfulness identifies any represented G with this heart extension; applying the heart inclusion gives the stated iso. The zero object, empty open, identity open and arbitrary representatives are covered.

theorem zlIndWeilOpenShriek_realization
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [QuasiCompact j₀.left]
    (S : SfCompactSupportCoefficientAction l D.k (zlRealizationPrimeUnit D l hl) Ω
      (.ofIsOpenImmersion (zlFiberMap D j₀)))
    (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω)
    (G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω)
    (e : (zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj G ≅
      (zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₀).obj
        ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F)) :
    Nonempty (G.obj.carrier ≅ S.system.functor.obj F.obj.carrier)
